message: In the under-deck Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) retrofit (C1), the crowd-walking comfort margin has needed confirmation against limits, Structural Dynamics Lead and Vibration Control Specialist. To check it I used standards review reusing the controlled-response stroke estimate (E6) against the resonant response calculation (E1). I found about 0.20 metres per second squared controlled versus 1.75 metres per second squared baseline below 0.5 metres per second squared maximum, according to Human Induced Vibrations of Steel Structures (HIVOSS), 2008. I propose holding Comfort Class 1 (CL1) meaning maximum comfort as build target. My position: not ready because joint proposal and girder fatigue review are pending. In the concealed under-deck support frame (C2), the install without deck closure and re-tuning access has risk of long closure, Retrofit Integration Architect and Manager. To check it I used build review reusing the concealed mounting cross-section (E7) with the detuned damping estimate (E8). I found fit below soffit with 30 millimetre clearance for under 12 millimetre stroke and night works from below, according to French Assessment Service for Roads and Motorways (Setra), 2006. I propose bolted cross-frames with lockable hatches and shim re-tuning. My position: not ready because blocking process check needs closure.
